Cleric Spell Access.description: Upon reaching 10th level, a rainbow servant gains the ability to learn and cast spells from the cleric spell list, even those not found on any of his existing spellcasting class lists. Spells taken from the cleric list that do not appear on the sorcerer/wizard or bard lists are treated as divine spells when cast. This grants access to the spells themselves but does not provide any additional spell slots per day. A 10th-level rainbow servant may also use scrolls, wands, and staffs containing cleric spells.

Detect Chaos.description: A rainbow servant of 7th level or higher can use detect chaos at will, functioning as the spell of the same name.

Detect Evil.description: A rainbow servant can use detect evil at will, functioning as the spell of the same name.

Detect Thoughts.description: A 10th-level rainbow servant can use detect thoughts at will, functioning as the spell of the same name. The saving throw DC for this ability is based on Charisma.

Extra Domain (Good).description: A rainbow servant receives the granted power and spell access of the Good domain at 1st level, the Air domain at 4th level, and the Law domain at 7th level. The rainbow servant typically employs a multicolored couatl feather as her divine focus.

Grow Wings.description: Beginning at 4th level, a rainbow servant can sprout multicolored feathered wings resembling those of a couatl. These wings grant a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. The total daily flight duration is 1 minute per rainbow servant level, which the character may divide into segments as desired. Growing or dismissing the wings requires a standard action. Any restrictive clothing or armor prevents the wings from forming, and a rainbow servant cannot manifest them while grappled.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: Each time a rainbow servant gains a new level in this prestige class, she receives additional spells per day as though she had also advanced one level in whichever arcane spellcasting class allowed her to cast 3rd-level spells prior to entering this class. She does not, however, receive any other benefits that class would normally grant (such as improved undead turning, wild shape, or similar abilities). In effect, her rainbow servant levels are added to her other spellcasting class level for purposes of calculating spells per day. If the character could cast 3rd-level arcane spells in more than one class before becoming a rainbow servant, she must choose which class receives the benefit each time she gains a rainbow servant level.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, wild shape ability, and so on). If a character had more than one spellcasting class in which she could cast 3rd-level arcane spells before she became a rainbow servant, the player must decide which class to assign each level of rainbow servant for the purpose of determining spells per day and spells known.
